key_moments: 2' Goal: Leroy Sané opens the scoring for Germany with an early strike.
9' Goal: Nilson Angulo quickly equalizes for Ecuador, breaking their tournament scoring drought.
Second half: A Germany penalty decision is overturned by VAR after a review for an earlier foul by Sané.
77' Goal: Gonzalo Plata scores the winning goal for Ecuador, poking it past Manuel Neuer after a flick-on from a corner.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the decisive late goal that secured Ecuador's qualification.
Netted the crucial equalizer and was influential on the wing throughout the match.

matches.tactical_summary: Ecuador demonstrated resilience, recovering from an early deficit by capitalizing on quick transitions and effective wing play to secure their victory. Germany, despite dominating possession, struggled to convert their territorial advantage into consistent scoring opportunities after their initial goal.

narrative: Ecuador staged a dramatic comeback to defeat already-qualified Germany 2-1, securing their progression to the knockout stage as one of the best third-placed teams from Group E. This result saw them rally from an early deficit, demonstrating resilience and effective counter-attacking play to upset the group winners and advance.
